remarks: This inviting home offers a wonderful blend of modern updates, comfort, and spacious indoor-outdoor living. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 1,927 square feet of living space on a generous 7,575-square-foot lot in Reseda. Step inside to a bright and spacious living room featuring beautiful flooring, recessed lighting, a cozy fireplace, and a charming front-facing bay window, offering the perfect setting for a beautifully decorated Christmas tree during the holidays. The beautifully remodeled kitchen showcases sleek cabinetry, elegant countertops, stainless steel appliances, a professional-style range, and a generous peninsula with seating.
